title: session
description: One row per lap, however short, and per break that ran for 60 s or more. The row id is the timer's run id, so two devices that saw the same interval end write the same row. Created once; only task, note and outcome change later.

ended.description: Server-time ms: the planned end if it rang, the moment it was stopped otherwise.

outcome.description: rang: minutes and a whole lap. stopped: minutes and a lap that ended early. void: not counted, the timeline only.

device.description: The device that wrote the row.
